data.description: Find tranquility amidst green landscapes, lakes, and trees at Emirates Living.

data.answer: Emirates Living is a premier residential destination that caters to the needs and preferences of discerning homeowners who value luxury, comfort, and quality living. Although these residences are away from fast-paced city life, they provide easy access to various family-centric amenities.

In Emirates Living, several properties are prevalent among residents and investors. Here are some of the most sought-after properties in the area:

Emirates Hills: Known for its exclusive luxury villas and prestigious golf course, Emirates Hills is one of the most desirable addresses in Dubai. The community offers spacious homes with stunning views of the green landscape and skyline. The sub-communities in the area include Montgomerie Hills, Dyaar Al Hambra, Montgomerie Maisonettes, and Signature Villas.

The Lakes: A gated community consisting of several sub-communities, The Lakes offers a variety of townhouses and villas surrounded by landscaped gardens and lakes. Residents enjoy easy access to parks, playgrounds, and community centers.

Meadows: Meadows boasts spacious villas in a tranquil setting. The community is known for its family-friendly environment and amenities such as parks, pools, and sports facilities. Similarly, properties in Meadows are set in distinct sub-communities with individual entry points. There is an assortment of 3 to 7-bedroom villas in Meadows that you can rent or invest in.

The Springs: Comprising townhouses and villas set around scenic lakes and parks, The Springs offers affordable yet stylish living options. The semi-detached and terraced villas and townhouses have various lifestyle amenities, including a souk, pools, and play areas. These properties come with 2, 3, and 4-bedroom configurations.

The Views: Located near Emirates Golf Club, The Views is a popular choice for young professionals and families. The community offers a range of apartments with views of the golf course or the Dubai Marina skyline.

The Greens: A master project of The Greens features elegantly designed low-rise apartments ranging from studios to 4-bedroom units. It comprises 40 elegantly crafted low-rise residential buildings spread across 10 complexes.

Off-Plan Projects in Emirates Living Community

Golf Heights is the final addition to this prestigious community, offering 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments. The project by Emaar Properties will offer various amenities including sports courts, retail centers, a yoga deck, and children's play areas.

Properties for Rent in Emirates Living

Villas for rent in Emirates Hills start from AED 370k, whereas in The Lakes, a 7-bedroom villa is available for AED 699k. You can find various properties for rent in The Lakes.

Meadows is also an excellent option for renting villas. To rent a 5-bedroom villa in Meadows, you must pay a minimum of AED 315k annually. If you are looking to rent townhouses or villas, The Springs is an ideal location. The starting rental price of a villa in The Springs is AED 140k per year and for a townhouse is AED 150k.

Studio apartments in The Views can be rented out for AED 72k and a 3-bedroom apartment is available for AED 170k. If you are looking for a rental apartment in a tranquil environment, The Greens is the best community with prices starting from AED 59k.

Properties for Sale in Emirates Living

Emirates Living property prices depend on the sub-community you are looking for. In Emirates Hills, a 5-bedroom villa is available for AED 32 million, whereas the bigger 9-bedroom villa is available for AED 75 million. You can find various properties for sale in The Lakes as well, starting from 3-bedroom villas available at a minimum price of AED 4.85 million. The largest 6-bedroom villa is available for AED 16 million. Likewise, you can find various options to buy properties in Meadows.

A 2-bedroom cozy villa is available in The Springs for 3.29 million.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Emirates Living Dubai?

data.answer:
Emirates Living is known for its upscale residences, including luxurious villas, townhouses, and apartments. Residents enjoy spacious living spaces with high-end finishes and modern amenities. Emirates Living is known for its upscale residences, including luxurious villas, townhouses, and apartments. Residents enjoy spacious living spaces with high-end finishes and modern amenities. It is designed to cater to families, with plenty of amenities and activities for children. Parks, playgrounds, and community centers offer spaces for families to relax and socialize.

Public Transportation in Emirates Living Dubai

The closest metro station to Emirates Living is Nakheel. Additionally, the F31 bus connects Dubai Internet City Metro station (via The Greens) with numerous stops along the route, including Springs Town Centre.

The community offers convenient connectivity to major thoroughfares in Dubai, including Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, and Emirates Road. This allows car owners to easily access various destinations across the city without any hassle.

Supermarkets in Emirates Living Community

In Emirates Living, residents have access to various supermarkets where they can purchase fresh groceries and daily necessities. These include Choithrams, Carrefour, Aswaaq Mart, and The Springs Souk.

Shopping Malls Near Emirates Living

Al Barsha Mall is located close to Emirates Living. Located behind Al Barsha Pond Park, the retail center also has a electronics stores, plus a hypermarket and a food court.

The community is conveniently situated just a short drive away from prominent shopping destinations in Dubai, such as Mall of the Emirates and Ibn Battuta Mall.

Schools in Emirates Living

Emirates Living boasts a selection of reputable schools catering to the educational needs of residents. Dubai International Academy (DIA) in Emirates Hills is an International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum. DIA provides education from KG1 to Grade 12. The school focuses on holistic development and academic excellence.

Emirates International School (EIS) in Meadows EIS offers a British curriculum and provides education from FS1 to Year 13. The school emphasizes academic rigor, personal development, and extracurricular activities. Similarly, Regent International School in The Greens follows the National Curriculum for England and provides education from FS1 to Year 13. The school focuses on fostering creativity, critical thinking, and character development.

Dubai British School (DBS) in Emirates Hills offers a British curriculum and provides education from FS1 to Year 13. The school aims to inspire students to become confident, responsible global citizens through academic excellence and personal growth. JSS International School, Delhi Private School Dubai, and Bright Riders School Dubai are some of the Indian schools in the district.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques near Emirates Living Area 

Masood Naqvi Mosque in Emirates Hills and Greens mosque are strategically located in the heart of the larger Emirates Living community.

Christ Church Jebel Ali and St Francis of Assisi Christ Church are 20 minutes away from the community. Similarly, Guru Nanak Darbar and Hindu Temple Dubai both are located in Jebel Ali at the same distance from the Emirates Living community.

Clinics and Hospitals near Emirates Living Community

White Clinic is 4 minutes away from the Emirates Living community, while Clover Medical Center is 9 minutes from the area. American Hospital Dubai Media City Clinic is also 10 minutes away from Emirates Living.

Emirates Living Location & Nearby Areas

Emirates Living enjoys a prime location in Dubai, surrounded by key areas such as Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Lake Towers, and Jumeirah Islands. This upscale residential community offers easy access to amenities and attractions, including shopping malls, dining options, and recreational facilities.

With proximity to Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City, and Sheikh Zayed Road, residents benefit from convenient connectivity to business hubs and major highways. Emirates Living's central location makes it a highly sought-after destination for those seeking a luxurious lifestyle in Dubai.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Emirates Living Dubai

data.answer:
Within the community lies the prestigious golfing haven, Emirates Hills, boasting one of the finest golf courses. Beyond golf, residents of Emirates Living can partake in a plethora of sports and fitness pursuits. Moreover, its advantageous location near world-class healthcare facilities and educational institutions enhances its appeal.

Restaurants in Emirates Living Dubai

Emirates Living boasts a variety of dining options within proximity. Residents can explore culinary delights at nearby eateries such as:

  • Shakespeare and Co. (Located in Springs Souk, approximately 5 minutes away)
  • Carluccio's (Located in The Greens, around 10 minutes away)
  • Wagamama (Located in The Greens, approximately 10 minutes away)
  • The Noodle House (Located in Dubai Marina Mall, roughly 15 minutes away)
  • Baker & Spice (Located in Souk Al Bahar, about 20 minutes away)

These restaurants offer a diverse range of cuisines to cater to different tastes, providing residents of Emirates Living with convenient dining options just a short distance from their homes.

Beaches Near Emirates Living Location

Jumeirah Beach Residence and Marina Beach, renowned coastal hotspots, are conveniently reachable within a 15-minute drive. Also, the picturesque Al Sufouh Beach and Jumeirah Public Beach area are a short drive away.

Hotels in and near the Emirates Living Dubai Area

Situated in the affluent Emirates Hills neighborhood of Dubai, Vida Emirates Hills Hotel is a lavish sanctuary. It presents an array of amenities and services, encompassing a fully equipped fitness center, a rooftop pool boasting stunning city vistas, and a variety of dining venues.

Emirates Living, situated in Dubai, is primarily a residential area renowned for its luxurious lifestyle and upscale amenities. While the community itself does not feature many hotels, there are several prestigious options located nearby to accommodate visitors. Among them is the Address Montgomerie, an elegant hotel adjacent to Emirates Living, offering luxurious accommodations overlooking the Montgomerie Golf Course. With fine dining restaurants

Attractions and Landmarks near Emirates Living

The Lakes Club is a favored recreational spot for residents, boasting a range of sports facilities such as a lap pool and a children's pool equipped with a slide. Additionally, there is a Fitness First gym offering classes and a squash court for enthusiasts. Alongside these active amenities, The Lakes Club also provides dining options.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Emirates Living features landscaped parks and green areas where residents can take leisurely walks, have picnics, or simply relax amidst nature. The community has designated cycling and jogging tracks, providing residents with opportunities for outdoor exercise and fitness activities.

Golf enthusiasts can indulge in a round of golf at nearby world-class golf courses such as Emirates Golf Club and Montgomerie Golf Club, both located within a short distance from Emirates Living. Moreover, Topgolf Dubai is another popular attraction nearby offering an amazing open sky golfing experience.

Those interested in working out can head over to Fitness First gym at the Meadows Village. Moreover, Vida Emirates Hills also has a gym and pool available for members. Barber Republic is the barber shop for gents in Emirates Hills, while there is Laloge Luxury Salon in the area as well.

While Dubai has an extensive public transportation network, including buses, metros, and trams, Emirates Living may not have as convenient access to these services compared to more central areas of the city. This could make car ownership a necessity, adding to expenses.

Is Emirates Living family-friendly?

Yes, Emirates Living is considered a family-friendly community with various amenities and facilities catering to residents of all ages. There are schools, nurseries, playgrounds, and recreational areas suitable for families with children.

What are the security measures in Emirates Living?

Security in Emirates Living is typically stringent, with gated entrances, CCTV surveillance, and 24/7 security patrols to ensure the safety and well-being of residents.

Are there shopping and dining options in Emirates Living?

Yes, Emirates Living Dubai features retail centers and shopping complexes within or near the community. Residents have access to supermarkets, convenience stores, cafes, restaurants, and other retail outlets for their daily needs.

How is the transportation infrastructure in Emirates Living?

Emirates Living is well-connected by road networks, making it easy for residents to commute to other parts of Dubai. While public transportation options such as buses and taxis are available, many residents prefer to use private vehicles for convenience.

What are the schools and healthcare facilities available in Emirates Living?

Emirates Living is home to reputable schools, nurseries, and educational institutions catering to various curricula. Additionally, there are healthcare clinics, pharmacies, and hospitals located nearby to meet the medical needs of residents.

data.content:
Emirates Living is a collection of green communities named The Greens, The Lakes, The Meadows, The Springs, The Views, and Emirates Hills, also known as the “Beverly Hills” of Dubai. These gated communities are away from the hustle and bustle of the city, amidst green landscapes, tree-lined streets, and serene lakes.

In 2003, Emaar introduced the project, offering residents tranquil settings for leisure and rejuvenation. The community comprises residential clusters of villas and townhouses along with apartment complexes.

Properties for sale in Emirates Living ensure the best returns on investment. Rental options are also available in the area, which provides residents with amenities such as schools, parks, retail centers, and kids' play areas. Additionally, the community offers easy access to major highways and transportation links, making it convenient for residents to travel within Dubai and beyond.
